name: Box Turn (backward half)
notes: Owner's description: follows Box Turn (forward half); back on the lead's left, side, close, turning a quarter to the right; no rise. Turn timing from the book: the partner going forward commences to turn on 1, then 1/8 between 1 and 2 and 1/8 between 2 and 3; the partner going back turns 1/4 between 1 and 2 and completes it on 3. The book's "body turns less" for the lead isn't drawn: pointing his count-2 foot further round lands its toes on the other foot. Reviewed by the owner (2026-11-19).
